name: Ca thoi loi
summary: Cá thòi lòi is the mudskipper of the cape flats. It swims, runs on the mud, and climbs. The Ngọc Hiển page says it is not bony and not strongly fishy.
origin: The mangrove flats of the cape. VOV calls it a newer dish that visitors ask for.
howToEat: Order it grilled, in a hotpot, kho tiêu, or dried.
The airline page repeats grill, kho tiêu, and hotpot.
where: The mangrove flats of the cape. No restaurant is named. Check on arrival for a price.
seoTitle: Ca thoi loi — Ca Mau mudskipper
seoDescription: Cá thòi lòi is the mudskipper of the Cà Mau flats, grilled, in a hotpot, kho tiêu, or dried. No stall price is printed.
